tweets.text:
Why @fomo is the best trading app in the world for normies:

I was literally nobody before I started trading on @fomo. Even I hit few 100x in the trenches before, no one recognized me. (I rode Cashcat from 3M to 150M with size before joining fomo but nothing changed) 

The reason for this is because i found it really hard to build something about my trade identity on other platforms. Even i had good thesis on some coins, i had to move over to https://t.co/irxiIRNDwG or TG groups to let ppl know, and nothing is archived when I change wallet address. This basically made the whole process (from buying, building a thesis, shilling, proving etc.) fragmented and I was too lazy to do all of them. 

Everything takes time to build properly. And building your social reach in the trenches are basically the same as other things, it takes much time and you need to hit good trade histories, also need to select a right way to promote it, which is really challenging for normal traders.

Onchain trading have grown a lot for the past few years, and it made so many heros thru various platforms. (we call them KOLs, callers, influencers, etc.) and it's lowkey really hard to stand out when you especially start from 0. 

I joined @fomo few weeks ago to try out the app and luckily i was able to hit few good trades (Cashcat, Marscoin, GME, etc.). I literally tried to leverage all my past experience losing money in the trenches for the past few years. Only thing i did was just buy and write some short thesis about my trade. And I realized after a short term period of time, ppl started to follow me and i became famous, which has been literally a life changing experience for me. It feels truly blessed and much appreciated, I still feel like I am dreaming.

If I have to say something here, I would say @fomo app is the best place where heroes can actually be born and recognized. I would strongly recommend to ppl out there who have been struggling in the wild, come join @fomo and spread your wings. 

Few reasons why: 

1. @fomo basically integrates and covers every process of an onchain trading cycle, from finding alphas, buy/sell, posting a thesis. It's different from others because it has strong social features.

2. You don't need to leave the app. For now i use other apps to find early alphas but if you are not a hardcore trader, everything is there. 

3. Leaderboard features will make you grind harder, and making to the top of leaderboard will pay off, even one or two 10x, 100x trades will make u up there. The notional hurdle to the leaderboard is not that too high.

4. Here is where the snowball effect comes in, the numbers will compound in a very fast speed if you're able to somehow keep that momentum.

I still think there's a long way to go for myself to become a good/successful trader. I make a lot of stupid trades, top blasting, waving in my conviction and cutting losses (or being rugged). I was born in the trenches, aping in 10k mc coins hoping them to hit millies. This is regardless of my balance or net worth, I just love to play around in the trenches, finding the next Pepe, Fartcoin, Brett, Moodeng, Wif. 

I'd love to see many random names out there suddenly popping up and become a hero, and I'm sure you'll gonna make it on @fomo.

One last thing, wanna give a s/o to the goated team @seyong @KrutzkyTrades @paulerlanger + others for building this amazing app, and truly wish your continued success.

WAGMI and all the best to everyone.
